title: Portuguese Stew
description: A hearty stew originating from Portugal, made with tender beef, vegetables, and a rich broth. Serve with crusty bread for a comforting meal.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
4. Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
6. Add the crushed tomatoes, beef broth, and browned beef to the pot.
7. Stir in the chopped potatoes and bring the stew to a boil.
8. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
